title.narrative: Strengthening Accountability for Efficient and Transparent Public Expenditure Implementation

description.narrative: The development objective of the Project is to improve the efficiency, transparency, and accountability in the implementation of public funds, by building the capacity of the Court of Accounts (CoA) to become a well-functioning Supreme Audit Institution (SAI). Given the low capacity of the CoA, no independent accountability and feedback loop mechanisms exist in practice to ensure that public sector programs are delivered effectively and efficiently. Therefore, the Project will support the CoA in: i) reviewing the existing legal framework and practices, to ensure effectiveness, professionalism and independence, ii) establishing audit methodologies and capacity building for financial and compliance audits of public sector program implementation, meeting international good practices and risk-based audit approaches, and iii) developing citizen engagement mechanisms to complete the accountability cycle through increased stakeholder feedback over the government's delivery of services. The expected implementation period for this project is three years. This IDF is directly aligned with the Country Assistance Strategy (CAS) FY2009-2012, which highlights the need to re-enforce financial controls, including more timely and higher quality reporting and audits, as one of the main priorities for improving public finance. While all diagnostic reviews have highlighted the great need for support and technical assistance and capacity building to strengthen CoA's role and performance, the donor community's support to CoA to date is still very limited. Component (1) Legal Framework Activities: i) review of existing legal framework ii) Develop internal bylaws based on CoA's mandate and amended law Component (2) Development of audit methodology and guidelines in compliance with international standards and good practices, and risk-based audit approaches Activities: i) developing audit methodologies for financial audit and compliance audit that will provide stronger independent evidence over implementation of public sector programs ii) Pilot audits and evaluation of audit execution iii) development of training programs and curricula iv) delivery of training programs in the new audit methodologies Component (3) Development of mechanisms for citizen engagement Activities: i) assessment of CoA's strategy and mechanisms for citizen feedback on public sector program delivery. ii) design and implementation of a pilot citizen engagement project, including dissemination and follow-up of audit findings, fostering of social accountability mechanisms and participative discussion. Component (4) Grant management and financial statements audit Activities: i) project audit, ii) direct training of CoA employees, who will perform management, FM, and Procurement activities of the Project
